dialog.english: It's reacting. But why here?
dialog.translation: Reacciona. ¿Pero por qué aquí?

dialog.english:
It's the Digivice. Did a crow pick
it up and bury it in its nest?
dialog.translation:
Es el Digivice. ¿Lo cogería un
cuervo y lo enterraría en su nido?

dialog.english:
Hey, Wizarmon! What are you doing
here?
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, Wizardmon! ¿Qué haces
aquí?

dialog.english: Nothing in particular...
dialog.translation: Nada en especial...

dialog.english:
Nothing? In the middle of nowhere?
You found something, didn't you?
dialog.translation:
¿Nada? ¿En medio de la nada?
Has encontrado algo, ¿a que sí?

dialog.english:
Well, I did find *something*,
but...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, sí que he encontrado
ALGO, pero...

dialog.english: What?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué?

dialog.english:
...This world turned out to be
surprisingly enjoyable. Before I
knew it, I was already drunk...
dialog.translation:
...Este mundo resultó ser
muy divertido. Cuando me di
cuenta, ya estaba borracho...

dialog.english: *hiccup*
dialog.translation: (hip)

dialog.english:
What are you doing?! If you don't
stop goofing off, you'll be erased
like Pumpmon and Gotsumon!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Qué haces?! ¡Si no dejas de
hacer el tonto, te borrarán
como a Pumpmon y Gotsumon!

dialog.english:
Please keep this a secret from
Lord Myotismon.
dialog.translation:
Por favor, no se lo digas al
Amo Myotismon.

dialog.english:
Man, Tailmon's buddies are all a
bunch of good-for-nothings...
dialog.translation:
Vaya, los colegas de Gatomon
son unos inútiles...

dialog.english:
I can't afford to hand over this
Digivice to Myotismon...
dialog.translation:
No puedo darle este Digivice
a Myotismon...

dialog.english:
But the Digivice is here. So then
where is the eighth child...?
dialog.translation:
Pero el Digivice está aquí.
Entonces, ¿dónde está el
octavo niño...?

dialog.english:
Hello! This is the Yagami
residence! Ah, Joe. How'd it go?
Did you find the eighth child?
dialog.translation:
¿Sí? ¡Casa de los Yagami! Ah,
Joe. ¿Qué tal? ¿Encontraste al
octavo niño?

dialog.english: I couldn't find anyone at all.
dialog.translation: No he encontrado a nadie.

dialog.english:
We're the only ones who moved out
of Karigaoka...
dialog.translation:
Solo nosotros nos mudamos
de Hikarioka...

dialog.english: That can't be right...
dialog.translation: No puede ser...

dialog.english:
But I called everyone in the
directories I have. The only one
left is yours, Tai...
dialog.translation:
Pero he llamado a todos los de
mis listas. Solo queda la
tuya, Tai...

dialog.english: I...still haven't found that yet.
dialog.translation:
Yo... todavía no la he
encontrado.

dialog.english:
It's the only clue we have left!
Go and look for it again! And do
it thoroughly!
dialog.translation:
¡Es la única pista que nos
queda! ¡Búscala otra vez! ¡Y a
fondo!

dialog.english: I know, I know...
dialog.translation: Que sí, que sí...

dialog.english: I know, I know...
dialog.translation: Que sí, que sí...

dialog.english: I'm done for...
dialog.translation: Estoy acabado...

dialog.english:
Who is it this time? Hello, Yagami
residence.
dialog.translation:
¿Quién será ahora? Sí, casa
de los Yagami.

dialog.english: Tai, is that you?
dialog.translation: Tai, ¿eres tú?

dialog.english: Ah, Matt!
dialog.translation: ¡Ah, Matt!

dialog.english:
Did you hear about the incident in
Shibuya on the news?
dialog.translation:
¿Has oído en las noticias lo
que ha pasado en Shibuya?

dialog.english:
Shibuya? Something about acute
anemia and a lot of women getting
kidnapped?
dialog.translation:
¿Shibuya? ¿Algo de anemia
aguda y de muchas mujeres
secuestradas?

dialog.english: We were in Shibuya just now!
dialog.translation: ¡Acabamos de estar en Shibuya!

dialog.english: Huh?! So that news report...
dialog.translation: ¡¿Eh?! Entonces la noticia...

dialog.english:
We were attacked by Myotismon. He
killed two of his own minions!
dialog.translation:
Nos atacó Myotismon. ¡Mató a
dos de sus propios esbirros!

dialog.english: What?!
dialog.translation: ¡¿Qué?!

dialog.english:
Tai... we really don't know
what he'll do next. We have to
find the eighth child, and soon.
dialog.translation:
Tai... no sabemos qué hará
ahora. Tenemos que encontrar
al octavo niño, y pronto.

dialog.english: Yeah, you're right.
dialog.translation: Sí, tienes razón.

dialog.english: Are you watching that Kari girl?
dialog.translation:
¿Estás vigilando a esa tal
Kari?

dialog.english:
Wizarmon... have you found the
eighth child yet?
dialog.translation:
Wizardmon... ¿ya has
encontrado al octavo niño?

dialog.english: No, but I found this.
dialog.translation: No, pero he encontrado esto.

dialog.english: A Digivice! Why do you have that?
dialog.translation:
¡Un Digivice! ¿Por qué lo
tienes tú?

dialog.english: I found it in a crow's nest.
dialog.translation:
Lo encontré en el nido de
un cuervo.

dialog.english:
Where? Shouldn't the eighth child
be somewhere around there?
dialog.translation:
¿Dónde? ¿El octavo niño no
debería estar por allí?

dialog.english:
No, the eighth child isn't there,
but...
dialog.translation:
No, el octavo niño no está
allí, pero...

dialog.english:
Isn't their location somewhere
inside your heart?
dialog.translation:
¿No estará en algún lugar de
tu corazón?

dialog.english: Inside my heart...
dialog.translation: En mi corazón...

dialog.english:
Are you afraid of recovering your
memories? You shouldn't be afraid
to take back your past.
dialog.translation:
¿Te da miedo recuperar tus
recuerdos? No deberías temer
recuperar tu pasado.

dialog.english: Wizarmon...
dialog.translation: Wizardmon...

dialog.english:
Until I met you, I was always
alone.
dialog.translation:
Hasta conocerte, siempre
estuve solo.

dialog.english:
I always traveled alone....I
couldn't make any friends...
dialog.translation:
Siempre viajaba solo... No
conseguía hacer amigos...

dialog.english:
Hungry, tired, lonely...even when
I fell nobody came to help me.
dialog.translation:
Con hambre, cansado, solo...
incluso cuando caía, nadie
venía a ayudarme.

dialog.english:
I thought my life would come to an
unsatisfying end, but then you
saved me.
dialog.translation:
Pensé que mi vida acabaría
sin pena ni gloria, pero
entonces tú me salvaste.

dialog.english: Did something like that happen?
dialog.translation: ¿Pasó algo así?

dialog.english:
Lonely and with a hardened heart,
I was about to throw away my
life...
dialog.translation:
Solo y con el corazón
endurecido, estaba a punto
de tirar mi vida...

dialog.english:
And the one who saved me from my
loneliness was you, Tailmon...
dialog.translation:
Y quien me salvó de mi
soledad fuiste tú, Gatomon...

dialog.english:
And I'm certain that back then,
you said to me, "I've always been
waiting for someone..."
dialog.translation:
Y estoy seguro de que entonces
me dijiste: "Siempre he
estado esperando a alguien..."

dialog.english: I was...waiting?
dialog.translation: ¿Yo...esperaba?

dialog.english: Yes, that's what you said.
dialog.translation: Sí, eso es lo que dijiste.

dialog.english: Who was I waiting for?
dialog.translation: ¿A quién esperaba?

dialog.english: Let's find out...
dialog.translation: Averigüémoslo...

dialog.english: Miko! Miko, where are you?
dialog.translation: ¡Miko! Miko, ¿dónde estás?

dialog.english: Who are you?!
dialog.translation: ¡¿Quién eres?!

dialog.english: I'm Wizarmon.
dialog.translation: Soy Wizardmon.

dialog.english: Did you fly here?
dialog.translation: ¿Viniste volando?

dialog.english:
Ah! You're the one I met earlier!
So you really *are* a friend of
Koromon, right?
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! ¡Tú eres el de antes!
Entonces sí que eres amigo
de Koromon, ¿no?

dialog.english: Here, take this Digivice!
dialog.translation: ¡Toma este Digivice!

dialog.english: What's this?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué es esto?

dialog.english: What?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué?

dialog.english:
Is this girl the eighth Chosen
Child?
dialog.translation:
¿Esta niña es el octavo Niño
Elegido?

dialog.english: Yes, she is.
dialog.translation: Sí, lo es.

dialog.english: So then who's her Digimon?
dialog.translation: ¿Y quién es su Digimon?

dialog.english:
Please, remember...remember who
you were waiting for.
dialog.translation:
Por favor, recuerda...
recuerda a quién esperabas.

dialog.english:
That's right, I was definitely
waiting.
dialog.translation:
Es verdad, yo esperaba a
alguien.

dialog.english:
Ever since I was in my Baby form,
Nyaromon, I waited and waited, but
nobody came.
dialog.translation:
Desde que era Nyaromon, de
bebé, esperé y esperé, pero
no vino nadie.

dialog.english:
When I evolved into Plotmon, I 
stopped waiting and went on a 
journey to find them myself...
dialog.translation:
Cuando evolucioné a Salamon, dejé
de esperar y salí a buscarla
por mi cuenta...

dialog.english:
But the one who appeared before me
wasn't the eighth Chosen Child,
but Myotismon...
dialog.translation:
Pero quien apareció ante mí no
era el octavo Niño Elegido,
sino Myotismon...

dialog.english:
And then the days of despair
began, and at some point I forgot
that I was waiting for someone...
dialog.translation:
Así empezaron los días de
desesperación, hasta que
olvidé que esperaba a alguien.

dialog.english:
I-I don't understand. What's the
eighth Chosen Child?
dialog.translation:
N-no lo entiendo. ¿Qué es eso
del octavo Niño Elegido?

dialog.english: Heeeeeey! Kari!
dialog.translation: ¡Eeeeh! ¡Kari!

dialog.english: Tai!
dialog.translation: ¡Tai!

dialog.english: You're...
dialog.translation: Sois...

dialog.english: Wait! Hear us out!
dialog.translation: ¡Espera, óyenos!

dialog.english:
Kari, get away from them! These
guys are our enemies!
dialog.translation:
Kari, ¡apártate de ellos!
¡Son nuestros enemigos!

dialog.english:
Get away from her, both of you!
Baby Flame!
dialog.translation:
¡Apartaos de ella, los dos!
¡Llama Bebé!

dialog.english: Stop it...
dialog.translation: Parad...

dialog.english: Kari! Get out of the way!
dialog.translation: ¡Kari! ¡Apártate de ahí!

dialog.english: Tailmon!
dialog.translation: ¡Gatomon!

dialog.english:
I'm fine, Kari. That's not
enough to hurt me.
dialog.translation:
Estoy bien, Kari. Eso no
me hace daño.

dialog.english:
Tailmon just threw herself in
front of Kari...
dialog.translation:
Gatomon se interpuso entre
Kari y el ataque...

dialog.english:
Have you recovered the memories
you locked away?
dialog.translation:
¿Recuperaste los recuerdos
que tenías bloqueados?

dialog.english:
Yes. I was waiting for the eighth
Chosen Child... I was waiting for
Kari.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Esperaba al octavo Niño
Elegido... Esperaba a Kari.

dialog.english: So Tailmon is my Digimon!
dialog.translation: ¡Gatomon es mi Digimon!

dialog.english:
That's right. Kari is the eighth
Chosen Child.
dialog.translation:
Así es. Kari es el octavo
Niño Elegido.

dialog.english: And I'm her Digimon...
dialog.translation: Y yo soy su Digimon...

dialog.english:
Okay, Tailmon, so even if this is
true, who's that guy over there?
dialog.translation:
Vale, Gatomon, aunque sea
verdad, ¿quién es ese tío
de ahí?

dialog.english: He's my friend.
dialog.translation: Es mi amigo.

dialog.english:
You can't just expect me to
believe that!
dialog.translation:
¡No pretendas que me crea
eso sin más!

dialog.english:
It doesn't matter if you believe
me or not, but at least take the
Digivice.
dialog.translation:
No importa si me crees o no,
pero al menos coge el
Digivice.

dialog.english:
Why are you giving her Digivice to
Tai?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué le das su Digivice
a Tai?

dialog.english:
It would be dangerous if Myotismon
found out about Kari and
Tailmon.
dialog.translation:
Sería peligroso que Myotismon
descubriera lo de Kari y
Gatomon.

dialog.english:
But if you have the Digivice, both
of them will be safe.
dialog.translation:
Pero si tú tienes el Digivice,
las dos estarán a salvo.

dialog.english:
Okay, I'll take care of this. What
are you gonna do now?
dialog.translation:
Vale, yo me encargo. ¿Y
vosotros qué haréis ahora?

dialog.english:
We need Kari's Crest. The real
one...
dialog.translation:
Necesitamos el Emblema
real de Kari...

dialog.english: Real?
dialog.translation: ¿Real?

dialog.english:
The one we have is a fake.
Myotismon has the real one.
dialog.translation:
El que tenemos es falso.
Myotismon tiene el auténtico.

dialog.english:
Wait here. We'll go and bring it
back.
dialog.translation:
Esperad aquí. Iremos a
recuperarlo.

dialog.english:
Wait! Where's Myotismon's base?
We'll go with you.
dialog.translation:
¡Espera! ¿Dónde está su base?
Vamos con vosotros.

dialog.english: You can't. It's too dangerous.
dialog.translation: No podéis. Es muy peligroso.

dialog.english: Tailmooooooon!
dialog.translation: ¡Gatomooooooon!

dialog.english:
Kari's Crest should be hidden
around here.
dialog.translation:
El Emblema debe estar
escondido por aquí.

dialog.english:
This place is off-limits until
Lord Myotismon returns!
dialog.translation:
¡Zona prohibida hasta que
vuelva el Amo Myotismon!

dialog.english:
We came to switch out the guard.
See?
dialog.translation:
Venimos a relevar la
guardia. ¿Ves?

dialog.english: Huh? What was I doing here?
dialog.translation: ¿Eh? ¿Qué hacía yo aquí?

dialog.english:
Weren't you going to switch off
with us and go home?
dialog.translation:
¿No ibas a relevarnos e
irte a casa?

dialog.english: Ah, right...Okay, I'll be leaving.
dialog.translation: Ah, cierto...Vale, me marcho.

dialog.english: Good night.
dialog.translation: Hasta luego.

dialog.english:
Where's the Crest? We have to
hurry up and find it.
dialog.translation:
¿Dónde está el Emblema? Hay
que encontrarlo ya.

dialog.english:
Don't rush things. Myotismon won't
return until dawn.
dialog.translation:
No corras. Myotismon no
volverá hasta el amanecer.

dialog.english: Here it is!
dialog.translation: ¡Aquí está!

dialog.english:
No doubt about it, it's the real
Crest.
dialog.translation:
No hay duda, es el Emblema
auténtico.

dialog.english:
So what are you going to do, now
that you've stolen the real Crest?
dialog.translation:
¿Y qué pensáis hacer, ahora
que habéis robado el
Emblema auténtico?

dialog.english: What!?
dialog.translation: ¡¿Qué?!

dialog.english:
Have you allied yourselves with
the Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
¿Os habéis aliado con los
Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
Those eyes of yours...I always
knew they were like a dagger
pointed my way.
dialog.translation:
Esos ojos tuyos...siempre
supe que eran como una
daga apuntándome.

dialog.english: I'll take you down!
dialog.translation: ¡Te derrotaré!

dialog.english:
I'll take care of you first,
Wizarmon.
dialog.translation:
Primero me encargaré de
ti, Wizardmon.

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaargh!
dialog.translation: ¡Aaaaaaaaargh!

dialog.english:
Myotismon, I'm the one you should
be fighting!
dialog.translation:
¡Myotismon, soy yo contra
quien debes luchar!

dialog.english:
Those eyes! They're shining with
the light of hope, the light that
believes in dreams...
dialog.translation:
¡Esos ojos! Brillan con la
luz de la esperanza, la luz
que cree en los sueños...

dialog.english:
That's right! I've made it this
long because I believed in that!
dialog.translation:
¡Así es! ¡He llegado hasta
aquí porque creía en eso!

dialog.english:
If I believe in it, I can have
hopes and dreams! And I'll defeat
you to make my dream come true!
dialog.translation:
¡Si creo en ello, puedo tener
esperanzas y sueños! ¡Te derrotaré
y cumpliré mi sueño!

dialog.english: What?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué?

dialog.english:
I can't take back my true self
unless I defeat you!
dialog.translation:
¡No recupero mi verdadero
yo si no te derroto!

dialog.english:
Take back your true self...could
you possibly be the eighth
Digimon?!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Recuperar tu verdadero
yo...serás acaso el
octavo Digimon?!

dialog.english:
I see! Now *that's* a completely
different story! First, I'll send
your precious friend to hell!
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya, eso ya es otra historia!
¡Antes, enviaré a tu preciado
amigo al infierno!

dialog.english: Tailmon!
dialog.translation: ¡Gatomon!

dialog.english: Wizarmon!
dialog.translation: ¡Wizardmon!

dialog.english: Wizarmon!
dialog.translation: ¡Wizardmon!

dialog.english: Hahahaha!
dialog.translation: ¡Jajajaja!

dialog.english: We came to help you, Tailmon!
dialog.translation: ¡Venimos a ayudarte, Gatomon!

dialog.english: Tai!
dialog.translation: ¡Tai!

dialog.english:
What a privilege it is, to see you
come to me so easily.
dialog.translation:
Qué privilegio veros venir
hasta mí tan fácilmente.

dialog.english: Gaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: ¡Gaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Greymon, evolve!
dialog.translation: ¡Evoluciona!

dialog.english:
You think I'll be beaten by such
child's play?
dialog.translation:
¿Crees que un truco de
niños me va a derrotar?

dialog.english: Gh!
dialog.translation: ¡Gh!

dialog.english:
The fact that a Chosen Child came
out here to help you means that 
you really are the eighth Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Que un Niño Elegido haya venido
a ayudarte demuestra que de
verdad eres el octavo Digimon.

dialog.english:
W-what are you talking about? I'm
not the eighth Digimon at all.
dialog.translation:
¿Q-qué dices? Yo no soy el
octavo Digimon en absoluto.

dialog.english:
We'll see about that. I'll use you
as bait to lure out the eighth
child.
dialog.translation:
Ya lo veremos. Te usaré de
cebo para atraer al octavo
niño.

dialog.english:
I may not have the Crest anymore,
but I'll find the eighth child
soon enough...
dialog.translation:
Puede que ya no tenga el
Emblema, pero encontraré
al octavo niño muy pronto...

dialog.english: That's cheap, Myotismon!
dialog.translation: ¡Qué ruin, Myotismon!

dialog.english: Farewell for now...
dialog.translation: Adiós por ahora...

dialog.english: Wait...
dialog.translation: ¡Espera!

dialog.english: Muahahahahaha...
dialog.translation: Muajajajaja...

dialog.english:
Tailmon... You'll come back,
right? You'll come back...
dialog.translation:
Gatomon...volverás,
¿verdad? Volverás...

dialog.english: Tailmoooooooooooon!
dialog.translation: ¡Gatomoooooooon!
